title: Console: onboarding checklist UI (step drawer, deep links, feature-flag gating + initial telemetry)
author: Dylan Brooks
description: Implements the MVP Console UI for the guided onboarding / first production launch checklist. This adds: (1) a checklist entry point on the Console home/dashboard with feature-flag gating, (2) a checklist panel with step states (not started / in progress / complete / blocked), (3) a step detail drawer with acceptance criteria + context + deep links to relevant Console pages and docs, and (4) initial client-side telemetry hooks for funnel analysis (viewed checklist, opened step, clicked CTA/deep link). This PR is UI-only and assumes progress is computed by the progress service API (see PR-28431) and event emission is handled server-side (PR-28452). Scope notes: we intentionally keep copy short (per DES-418) and defer in-product guided tours and remediation suggestions. Feature flag: `console.onboarding_checklist.enabled` with cohorting handled by the Console config/flag service; when disabled, the entry point is hidden and direct routes return a 404-ish "Not available" empty state. Data/Privacy: telemetry payload includes tenant_id, user_id, checklist_version, step_id, action, and route; no prompts, request bodies, or API keys are ever logged. Accessibility: keyboard navigation for the checklist list + drawer, focus trap in drawer, ARIA labels for status chips, and high-contrast status colors aligned with Console tokens. QA: adds component tests for state rendering, route guards for the feature flag, and Cypress coverage for open/close drawer + CTA deep link behaviors. Follow-ups: error handling for intermittent state API failures is basic (retry + toast); we’ll improve per dogfood feedback and integrate richer empty states later.

conversation: Kenji Nakamura (design): Step drawer looks good. Two nits: (1) status chip copy should be Title Case to match Console patterns, (2) drawer needs a clear affordance for external docs links (open in new tab + icon).

Dylan Brooks (author): Updated chip copy to Title Case and added external-link icon + `target=_blank` with `rel=noopener noreferrer` for docs CTAs. Also ensured deep links to Console pages remain same-tab.

Tessa Morgan (design): Please keep the step descriptions to 1–2 lines max; the current copy for "Set up retries/timeouts" wraps to 4 lines in 1280px. Suggest moving detail into acceptance criteria bullets.
Dylan Brooks (author): Done. Condensed step description and moved the longer guidance into acceptance criteria + "Learn more" link.

Logan Wright (telemetry): Event names should follow `console.onboarding_checklist.*` namespace. Also avoid sending route params (high cardinality). Suggest: `checklist_viewed`, `step_opened`, `cta_clicked` with fields `{step_id, cta_type, destination}` (destination as enum).
Dylan Brooks (author): Renamed events + removed raw URL emission. `destination` is now enum: `console_deeplink`, `docs`, `support_contact`, `billing`. Added unit test to ensure we never send `href`.
Chloe Martin (console backend): UI calls `GET /api/onboarding/checklist/v1/state`. Please handle 404 from feature flag mismatch gracefully (don’t spam error toasts).
Dylan Brooks (author): Added route guard + suppressed toast for 404; show "Not available" empty state with request-id only for debugging.
Leila Farouk (QA): Cypress flaked on focus-trap assertion. Can we assert `aria-modal=true` and close-on-esc instead of checking exact focused element?
Dylan Brooks (author): Adjusted test to assert modal semantics + escape close behavior. Reran CI; green.
Logan Wright: Approved (telemetry changes look good).
Tessa Morgan: Approved after copy changes.
